archiveDeclarations.declaration: An exchange offer must remain distinct from the actual service instance. Original source: Independent clinics, repair workshops, seed custodians and remote utility crews have reliable local suppliers but no shared way to reserve scarce transport capacity. The Wayfarer Union asks the commander to demonstrate a receiving-based dispatch service across the Avenor cluster. A refrigerated clinic delivery, a closed repair exchange, an agricultural seed transfer and a real crew recovery establish the service records. Restoring an external utility handoff makes the final route viable. The participating operators then choose either pooled route windows or protected local reservations. The commander validates the published charter and earns accreditation. Afterwards, the Exchange continues as a visible board of six original service templates, with actual consignments, declared requirements and transparent quotes.
